reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: The metachars private pointer starts null and becomes the sole owner of malloc storage holding the selected metacharacter byte set plus NUL.
owner_creation.invariant: A nonnull pointer owns one helper heap allocation.
limitations: metachars alone names the helper malloc block; counts are separate scalars.

aliases_escapes.analysis: strchr and strcpy receive borrowed aliases during direct calls; no external API returns the metachars pointer, but growth retires all aliases of the old allocation.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Borrowed metacharacter pointers cannot span growth.
limitations: An old metachars address cannot survive add_metachar growth.

callback_targets.analysis: The metachars field contains string data, never callable addresses; is_metachar calls strchr synchronously without retained context.
callback_targets.invariant: Character-set storage cannot register a callback.
limitations: is_metachar reads synchronously and retains no pointer after return.

invalidation.analysis: When capacity grows, old text is copied to p and old storage freed before metachars=p; no code uses the old pointer after publication in the normal path.
invalidation.invariant: Replacement must not expose a retired string alias.

mutation_commit.analysis: The metachars pointer is assigned only after malloc/copy, but its size/count metadata uses unchecked signed updates and lacks a fallible owner transaction.
mutation_commit.invariant: Pointer publication does not prove capacity arithmetic.

release_pair.analysis: Growth pairs the old metachars malloc allocation with free; the final generation remains reachable until helper process exit.
release_pair.invariant: Each replaced allocation has one free operation.
limitations: A copied metachars pointer is not a second allocation owner.

error_cleanup.analysis: malloc failure exits before copying metachars; unchecked capacity arithmetic still lacks an explicit validated extent contract.
error_cleanup.invariant: Allocation failure and sizing failure are separate contracts.

signals_handoff.analysis: Private one-shot use of metachars excludes ordinary concurrent writers but does not turn its raw owner into a reusable safe API.
signals_handoff.invariant: M0-MEM-001 remains attached to this raw owner.
limitations: Current helper buffers remain raw C-shaped owners; unchecked growth/numeric arithmetic is recorded under M0-MEM-001, without claiming a demonstrated runtime failure.
